policy.brand_promise: hidden American city history, one city, one mystery, one source trail

directions.name: Archival Civic Investigation
directions.summary: Premium city-history evidence board: charcoal, archival paper, map blue, amber, copper.
directions.shorts_first_frame: City/neighborhood + proof object + 2-5 words, no skyline-only frame.
directions.thumbnail: One strong map/photo/document proof object, city name visible, 2-4 word mystery.
directions.why_recommended: Best match for source-first hidden-city-history and owner rejection of the old loud social palette.

directions.name: Map Room Noir
directions.summary: Darker investigative look with map-grid depth and restrained parchment labels.
directions.shorts_first_frame: Bolder noir map label with short location clue and amber proof marker.
directions.thumbnail: High-contrast map cut plus document/photo insert.
directions.why_recommended: Good for darker investigative episodes but slightly less warm/local than the default.

directions.name: City File Archive
directions.summary: Warmer archive-folder look with paper cards, stamped source labels, and less dark contrast.
directions.shorts_first_frame: Archive folder card with large city clue and source-object stamp.
directions.thumbnail: Warm paper dossier with a single proof photo/map tearout.
directions.why_recommended: Most archival, but may feel less modern in Shorts feeds than the default.
